name: Operation February
storyline: Set at the end of the 1980s, following a devastating mutual nuclear destruction between two great powers, humanity struggles to restart civilization. You play as an ATOM agent tasked with a scouting assignment: travel to the war-torn wastes, locate the source of an unknown signal, recover pre-war equipment, and clear out potential regional threats.
summary:
A small adventure in the world of ATOM RPG, inspired by well-known CRPGs

It was the end of the 80s. Two great powers perished in the abyss of radioactive fire as a result of guaranteed mutual destruction. However, the world does not tolerate emptiness - here and there small centers of a reviving civilization began to appear.
